content:
1. Read English for 15–30 minutes daily (stories, news, simple books).  
2. Learn 5–10 new words every day and use them in sentences.  
3. Practice speaking English daily (talk to yourself or a partner).  
4. Listen to English (songs, podcasts, movies) and repeat lines aloud.  
5. Improve grammar step by step (tenses, articles, prepositions).  
6. Write in English every day (5–10 sentences or a short paragraph).  
7. Keep a notebook for vocabulary, meanings, and examples.  
8. Focus on pronunciation (listen + repeat; learn common sounds).  
9. Use English in real life (messages, comments, small conversations).  
10. Review weekly: revise old words/grammar and test yourself.

If you tell me your level (beginner/intermediate) I can make these points easier or more advanced.
